author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt:
User reported frustration in screenshot showing:

$ deciduous --help | grep -i "delete\|remove\|unlink"
No matches found

The workflow that exposed this limitation:
1. Created initial graph structure
2. Validation error: "goal has too many children"  
3. Tried to remove edges to fix the mistake
4. Discovered no delete/unlink commands exist
5. Attempted direct SQLite manipulation as workaround (failed due to foreign keys)

This is a fundamental usability gap. Users cannot fix mistakes in their decision graphs. 
The only workaround documented was "plan carefully since there's no undo" - unacceptable UX.

User's exact words: "This is stupid, we should totally add this"

Scope: Add ability to delete nodes and remove edges from the decision graph.

title: Add delete and unlink commands to CLI
